subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should onProgressNarratorLifecycle, isProgressDraftVisible, and progressPreambleEnabled become the canonical public Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned progress lifecycle coordination?
rationale: The fields are additive and generic, but they permanently expose core narration and lifecycle concepts to third-party plugins; repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for that compatibility-sensitive SDK boundary.

options.title: Accept the typed lifecycle seam
options.body: Keep the three optional fields as the canonical channel-owned contract after fixing the Discord final-start gate and retaining API-baseline and package-boundary coverage.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Remove the public fields and route the coordination through an internal channel runtime seam, avoiding a new third-party compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Accept the typed lifecycle seam
recommendation.body: Keep the three optional fields as the canonical channel-owned contract after fixing the Discord final-start gate and retaining API-baseline and package-boundary coverage.
